note: Small RV park on George L. Smith State Park Rd at Twin City, on a wooded cove of the park's cypress millpond (Google calls it Bear Branch RV Park & Wildlife). The old bearbranchrvpark.com no longer resolves. --Claude
summary: Still no operator website, booking engine or other web presence; Google Maps place at the pin (341 George L Smith State Park Rd), not marked closed, 4.8 from 39 reviews, phone 478-494-0094 (matches), so the presence rule's Google path holds; price rests only on the RV Life $$ tier. No 2024+ operator rate. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Savannah 110 km); the family has not stayed here. Only change: dropped the RV Life rating line from the note (rating holds it).
flags: Missing website: no operator site, booking engine or Facebook page exists (bearbranchrvpark.com dead; web search 2026-10-29 finds nothing); the stored website is a Google Maps search link. Presence passes only on Google Maps: open listing, 4.8 / 39 reviews, phone 478-494-0094.

Long-stay character, for a human: of the Google reviews read 2026-10-29, two describe living there ('We lived on the campground for about 7 months' - 2 years ago; 'I stayed here for a few months while I was working in wadley' - 3 years ago), one an overnight ('We needed a place to harbor up for the night, and Bear Branch had a few spots. It featured full hookups and 30/50A service' - a year ago), one a first RV trip 6 months ago. Nightly stays are taken, so it reads as a mixed park, but it posts no nightly rate anywhere: if judged long-stay in character it fails five-test 2 (no posted nightly price, no booking engine) and the RV Life $$ tier would not stand in.
No 2024+ operator rate (no site or engine); the only price signal is RV Life's $$ tier. No gateway within 40 km, so a rate over US$50 would fail the gate.

Waterfront re-audit lead (do not change here): on Esri imagery the pin sits at the head of a cove of the millpond and RVs/pads appear right along the cove's south shore, open to the water; stored 'not waterfront' may be too low. Needs the full waterfront gate (site-level look, apron).
